text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Behold, my fans!
Behold, Air Groove-san!
Feast your eyes upon this advanced tactic!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not the same person I was before!
—I don't need your lectureeees!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rulership! It's Rulership!
She pulls off a brilliant victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There was... an extraordinary amount of determination in that run.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...?
Wasn't Rulership incredible today?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, there's an overwhelming intensity to her now
that doesn't rely on race dynamics or chance."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san.
That run just now was...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ruler, Trainer.
I watched your run today.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I-I-Is that so...?
W-Well... this is just how it is...
choice_data_list: (My voice is cracking, it's totally cracking.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Her desire to act tough didn't match her true feelings..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing how you won today made me realize it.
Ruler, it really is true that you and I are—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That it is... "different."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, her form and body control are unmistakably
what I taught her at the academy. And yet..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
How we perceive racing...
Our fundamental "philosophies" are just different.
Entirely so.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I consider racing to be a pure sport.
However, you treat it like a game.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If your philosophies differ, then in the end, no matter how far you go...
you'll never truly be the same.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, she was like that ever since she was little.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you raced other kids at the school,
you always tried to win with clever tactics.
And then...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I told you to limit board games to one hour a day, you just kept playing.
...Sneaking around in secret, too.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ugh... You saw through me...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yet that must be your true individuality.
Gaming is no longer just a hobby to you—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's your very way of life.
To be honest, I was skeptical before, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I now see clearly that your philosophy isn't wrong.
If that is the case, then—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Master that path. My guidance could not
bring out your true essence. However—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: For right now, there is someone who can draw it out.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Keep at it, Ruler.
...Just take care of your body, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her tone of voice was remarkably gentle
compared to usual.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: O-Ohhh... That Air Groove-san... acknowledged... me...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
And it's so vivid, too...
Ohhh, I... I am...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, hahahaha! How's that, Alv!?
The only one who can make Air Groove-san marvel is—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You're not the only one!
I'm in this tooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —And?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Show some frustration at least, come ooon...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Admire Groove remains unfazed. In every way, she looks strikingly like Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ruler, while the title of being from the School
might bind you in the future...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Do as you please. Unlike that classmate Umamusume of yours, you have no need to dwell on the past.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "...Classmate? ...The past?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...? What, you didn't know?
Then allow me to enlighten you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Air Groove whispered something quietly to Rulership.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Our talk doesn't drag on; it ends quickly.
And then—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer.
That concludes today's trials.
So—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Let us enter the fray.
To the final game of this year
—the 'Arima Kinen.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Many star players await.
Umamusume I know well, and ones I'll be facing for the very first time.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
However... I see. So that was it,
Air Groove-san. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta give her a proper challenge.
Not just the Queen, but her too.
